comment: M05S demo: the synthetic test city at chunk (2048, 2048), seed 4242 (decision log D72). Run once per world type; pass --level-type RWG --world shots-rwg for classic RWG. y as top+N stands N blocks above the column's top block, so the same list fits both world types.
title: Synthetic test city, seed 4242

shots.name: above
shots.caption: City from above: the 13 x 13-chunk synthetic city from its south-east corner, looking north-west.

shots.name: street
shots.caption: Street level: the north-south street through the city center, looking north.

shots.name: interior
shots.caption: Building interior: the top floor of the lot at chunk (2049, 2049), glowstone ceiling lights.

shots.name: edge
shots.caption: City edge: the east edge where the city meets RWG terrain, looking west.

shots.name: village
shots.caption: Landmark: the 2 x 2-chunk village core sewn into the city at (4..5, -5..-4), seen from the north-east: its edge ring of parks and its lane.

shots.name: lane
shots.caption: Landmark lane, just above street level: from the street at x = 3 across the soft-edge strip into the village core.

shots.name: soft-edge
shots.caption: Soft edge and reserved lot: the 2 x 2 core straddling the city's west edge, left as RWG made it, seen from the south-west.
